baseline.what: Ghost Marowak IPS (getStaticPokemon applies it on every run)
roamer IPS (getRoamers applies it on every run)
ability 2 := ability 1 where ability 2 is 0 (saveBasicPokeStats, every record)
Deoxys record stats := the hardcoded forme stats (load/savePokemonStats)

wild.what: encounter slots (level, level, species) of every wild table

obedience_evo_code.what: Deoxys/Mew obedience + Kanto-dex level/stone evolution checks (CODE)

wild_held_items.what: common/rare held item words of every base-stats record

catch_rate.what: catch rate of every base-stats record

starters.what: Oak's three starter descriptions (rewritten in place)

statics.what: StaticPokemon{} species words and level bytes
roamer species words and level bytes
special-music fix IPS + its species pool

trainer_parties.what: trainer party-type byte, party count and every party record
trainer_parties.source: gen3_offsets.ini [Fire Red (U) 1.0] TrainerData/TrainerEntrySize/TrainerCount; Gen3RomHandler.setTrainers (no repoint: counts never grow)

tms.what: TM text pointer sites (+copies within the search radius)

tutor_text.what: tutor text pointer sites (+copies within the search radius), written only once setTMMoves has walked the maps

tutor_compat.source: Gen3RomHandler.loadROMInfo MoveTutorCompatibility = MoveTutorData + 2*MoveTutorMoves (no INI key), = the table pret CanLearnTutorMove reads; Gen3RomHandler.setMoveTutorCompatibility

field_items.what: item-ball script and hidden-item words holding a TM
item-ball script and hidden-item words holding an allowed non-TM item

shops.what: item lists of the randomizable shops

national_dex.what: Pokedex script hook, national-dex flag checks, Oak/aide fixes (script + CODE)

free_space.what: 0xFF free space the fork repoints text/scripts into, packed from FreeSpace
free_space.source: gen3_offsets.ini [Fire Red (U) 1.0] FreeSpace up to the first pret symbol; every RomFunctions.freeSpaceFinder call scans forward from FreeSpace (audit: packed, PACKED_MAX_GAP)

base_stats.what: base stats of every record + the hardcoded Deoxys forme stats
